title: Give me that book! Give it to me!
summary: Глаголы с двумя дополнениями (**give, show, send, buy**): **give me the book** и **give the book to me**; порядок, когда дополнение — местоимение.
ru:
## Два дополнения
Некоторые глаголы могут иметь **два** дополнения: кому? и что? Это give (дать), show (показать), send (послать), buy (купить), tell (сказать), bring (принести), lend (одолжить).
> I **gave** Tom a book. — Я дала Тому книгу.
> Can you **show** me your photos? — Покажешь мне свои фото?

## Два порядка слов
Сказать можно двумя способами.
1. **глагол + кому + что** (без to / for)
> I gave **Tom the book**. — Я дала Тому книгу.
> She sent **me a letter**. — Она прислала мне письмо.
2. **глагол + что + to / for + кому**
> I gave **the book to Tom**.
> She sent **a letter to me**.

## to или for?
- **to** — give, send, show, lend, tell, bring: give it **to** me
- **for** — buy, make, cook, get: I bought a present **for** my mother. — Я купила подарок маме.
> Can you **make** a sandwich **for** me? = Can you make me a sandwich?

## Если «что» — местоимение (it, them)
Когда «что» — **it** или **them**, ставим его сразу после глагола, а потом **to / for + кому**.
> Give **it to me**. — Дай мне это. (не ~~Give me it~~)
> I sent **them to her**. — Я послала их ей.
> Show **them to us**. — Покажи их нам.

## Если «кому» — местоимение
Когда местоимение — человек (me, him, her, us, them), порядок свободный.
> Give **me** the keys. = Give the keys **to me**.
> Can you lend **him** some money? = Can you lend some money **to him**?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Give me it.~~ → Give **it to me**.
- ~~Give to me the book.~~ → Give **me the book**. / Give the book **to me**.
- ~~She sent to me a letter.~~ → She sent **me a letter**.
- ~~I bought to my mother a present.~~ → I bought **my mother a present**. / I bought a present **for my mother**.
en:
## Two objects
Some verbs can have **two** objects: a person and a thing. For example give, show, send, buy, tell, bring, lend.
> I **gave** Tom a book.
> Can you **show** me your photos?

## Two word orders
There are two ways to say it.
1. **verb + person + thing** (no to / for)
> I gave **Tom the book**.
> She sent **me a letter**.
2. **verb + thing + to / for + person**
> I gave **the book to Tom**.
> She sent **a letter to me**.

## to or for?
- **to** — give, send, show, lend, tell, bring: give it **to** me
- **for** — buy, make, cook, get: I bought a present **for** my mother.
> Can you **make** a sandwich **for** me? = Can you make me a sandwich?

## When the thing is a pronoun (it, them)
When the thing is **it** or **them**, we put it right after the verb, then **to / for + person**.
> Give **it to me**. (not ~~Give me it~~)
> I sent **them to her**.
> Show **them to us**.

## When the person is a pronoun
When the person is a pronoun (me, him, her, us, them), both orders are fine.
> Give **me** the keys. = Give the keys **to me**.
> Can you lend **him** some money? = Can you lend some money **to him**?

## Common mistakes
- ~~Give me it.~~ → Give **it to me**.
- ~~Give to me the book.~~ → Give **me the book**.
- ~~She sent to me a letter.~~ → She sent **me a letter**.
structure:
## Два способа
| Способ | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | verb + **person** + **thing** | I gave **Tom the key**. |
| 2 | verb + **thing** + **to / for** + person | I gave **the key to Tom**. |

## Когда «что» = it / them
| Правильно | Неправильно |
|---|---|
| Give **it to** me. | ~~Give me it.~~ |
| Show **them to** her. | ~~Show her them.~~ |
| Buy **it for** him. | ~~Buy him it.~~ |

## Какое слово после вещи
| to | for |
|---|---|
| give, send, show, lend, tell, bring | buy, make, cook, get, find |

## Формы местоимений
| Подлежащее | I | he | she | we | they |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Дополнение | **me** | **him** | **her** | **us** | **them** |

exercises.title: Вставьте местоимение
exercises.instruction: Вставьте правильное местоимение (me, him, her, us, them).
exercises.example: I like Tom. I often send **him** letters.

items.text: My sister is in London. I often write to {{her}}.
You are my friend. I'll give {{you}} my phone number.
We are your parents. Why don't you phone {{us}}?
I haven't got a pen. Can you give {{me}} one?
They are waiting. Tell {{them}} to come in.
Tom is ill. Please send {{him}} some flowers.
He bought a present {{for}} his mother.
Can you show your photos {{to}} me?
Could you send this letter {{to}} Tom?

exercises.title: Перепишите предложения
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, заменив слова в скобках на местоимение.
